title: Rafael and the Horizon
author: Zephyrine Nystrom
blurb: Yara Amberdale, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
